S01.title: Single call
S01.description: One successful tool call, then a final answer.

S02.title: Sequential calls
S02.description: Three tool calls across three model turns.

S03.title: Parallel calls
S03.description: Five tool calls emitted in one model turn.

S04.title: Long session
S04.description: Twenty-five sequential tool turns (limits raised so the run can finish).

S05.title: Tool raises
S05.description: A tool raises an exception. The trace should record the call as failed.

S06.title: Failure then retry
S06.description: A failing call is followed by a successful call in the next turn.

S07.title: Parallel batch with one failure
S07.description: Three calls in one turn; the middle one raises. Siblings may or may not be cancelled.

S08.title: Unknown tool
S08.description: The model calls a tool that does not exist. Nothing executes; the attempt should still be visible.

S09.title: Invalid argument type
S09.description: The model passes a string where an integer is required.

S10.title: Missing required argument
S10.description: The model omits a required argument.

S11.title: Duplicate call ids
S11.description: Two different calls in one turn share the same call id (a real provider glitch).

S12.title: Unicode and escape characters
S12.description: Arguments contain emoji, quotes, newlines, backslashes and non-Latin script.

S14.title: Structured output
S14.description: A tool returns a dict rather than a string.

S16.title: Synchronous tool
S16.description: A plain (non-async) tool, which frameworks typically run in a worker thread.

S17.title: Cancelled during a tool
S17.description: The run is cancelled 0.3 s into a 2 s tool call. The call started but never finished.

S18.title: Cancelled after tools completed
S18.description: Two tools finish, then the run is cancelled while the model is thinking. Completed calls must not disappear.

S19.title: Model error after tools
S19.description: Two tools finish, then the model provider fails. Completed calls must not disappear.

S20.title: Turn limit exceeded
S20.description: The model keeps calling tools past the framework's turn limit (3 model calls).

S21.title: Concurrent runs
S21.description: Two runs of the same agent execute concurrently. Each run's trace must contain only its own calls.

S22.title: Nested agent as tool
S22.description: The outer agent calls a 'delegate' tool that runs an inner agent, which calls its own tools.
